name: R014-ai-superpower-attack-lowered
why: Challenge 6. The opponent leads with Nidoqueen 701 (Superpower; White Herb). The player's Granbull 664 lowers its Attack with Intimidate at the start, and the White Herb undoes that on switch-in (ITEMEFFECT_ON_SWITCH_IN, battle_util.c:3312) and is used up. On turn 1 the player switches to Tauros 696: its Intimidate lowers Nidoqueen's Attack again and nothing undoes it. From turn 2 on, AI_CV_Superpower sees Attack below normal against a Normal-type target and gives -1 (battle_ai_scripts.s:2395). If the herb has not been used by turn 1, the turn-1 scoring already sees the lowered Attack.
